# Town of Pomfret municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 18; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term
Town of Pomfret, Official Results, Australian Ballot, March 3, 2026 (pomfretvt.us): Moderator -- Kevin Geiger 344 votes
Town of Pomfret, Official Results, Australian Ballot, March 3, 2026 (pomfretvt.us): Town Clerk -- Rebecca Fielder 356 votes
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Rebecca Fielder as Pomfret's Town Clerk

Town of Pomfret, Official Results, Australian Ballot, March 3, 2026 (pomfretvt.us): 'Town Treasurer & Tax Collector' -- Ellen DesMeules 337 votes. Pomfret's delinquent-tax collection is handled by an appointee (see the town officers page), so no separate collector post is created
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Ellen DesMeules as Pomfret's Town Treasurer

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Pomfret's five selectboard members as of June 2026: Benjamin Brickner, Steven Chamberlin, Emily Grube, John Peters Jr., and Marjorie Wakefield
Town of Pomfret, Official Results, Australian Ballot, March 3, 2026 (pomfretvt.us): Selectboard, three years -- Benjamin Brickner 318 votes; Selectboard, two years -- Marjorie Wakefield 327 votes

Town of Pomfret, Selectboard page (pomfretvt.us): lists the current board as Benjamin Brickner (Chair), John Peters Jr. (Vice Chair), Emily Grube, Eric Chase, and Kyle Hansen. Wakefield died in May 2026 and the Selectboard appointed Eric Chase to her seat; Steven Chamberlin resigned effective June 18, 2026 and Kyle Hansen was appointed to his seat. Neither Wakefield nor Chamberlin holds a seat now, and Wakefield is minted nowhere (see the justice of the peace election note)

offices.org_name: Town of Pomfret Board of Listers

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a board of listers of three on staggered three-year terms

Town of Pomfret, Official Results, Australian Ballot, March 3, 2026 (pomfretvt.us): Lister, three years -- Neil Lamson 329 votes; Lister, to finish a term -- Norman Buchanan 325 votes (Buchanan had been appointed to the vacant seat in 2025 and now holds it by election)
Town of Pomfret, 2025 Town Report (pomfretvt.us): the report's town officers table lists the third lister as Rebecca Fielder, who also serves as Town Clerk
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect three auditors on staggered three-year terms

Town of Pomfret, Official Results, Australian Ballot, March 3, 2026 (pomfretvt.us): the Auditor races for three-year, two-year, and one-year terms had NO declared candidates (write-ins 8, 7, and 4; blanks about 355 in each)

Town of Pomfret, Auditors page (pomfretvt.us): the page states the auditor seats are 'VACANT - please contact the Selectboard if you are interested in serving the Town as an appointed Auditor'. All three seats are created without memberships
Town of Pomfret, Official Results, Australian Ballot, March 3, 2026 (pomfretvt.us): Cemetery Commissioner, three years -- Susan Burgess 338 votes
Town of Pomfret, 2025 Town Report (pomfretvt.us): the report's town officers table lists cemetery commissioners Susan Burgess (Chair), Greg Greene, and Bruce Tuthill

Town of Pomfret, 2025 Town Report (pomfretvt.us): the report's town officers table lists six library trustees; the 2026 warning stood two three-year seats, one two-year seat to finish a term, and the remaining seats

Town of Pomfret, Official Results, Australian Ballot, March 3, 2026 (pomfretvt.us): Library Trustee, two years to finish a term -- Heather Durkel 325 votes. The two three-year seats had NO declared candidates, so they are created without memberships; the seats were held by Douglas Abbott and Betsy Rhodes

offices.org_name: Town of Pomfret Trustees of Public Funds

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns that hold trust funds elect trustees of public funds

Town of Pomfret, Official Results, Australian Ballot, March 3, 2026 (pomfretvt.us): Trustee of Public Funds, three years -- Marjorie Wakefield 326 votes. Wakefield died in May 2026, so her seat is created without a membership
Town of Pomfret, 2025 Town Report (pomfretvt.us): the report's town officers table lists trustees of public funds Robert Coates, Michael Doten, and Marjorie Wakefield

offices.title: Justice of the Peace
offices.org_name: Town of Pomfret Justices of the Peace

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Pomfret justices of the peace: Anne Bower, Michael Doten, Charles Gundersen, James Robinson, and Marjorie Wakefield. Four are minted; Wakefield died in May 2026 (see the election note), so her seat stands vacant. The town report's officers table styles Gundersen 'Chuck Gundersen' and Robinson 'Jim Robinson'

jp_election.name: Town of Pomfret Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): the certified listing names five winners for Pomfret's five justice of the peace seats: Anne Bower, Michael Doten, Charles Gundersen, James Robinson, and Marjorie Wakefield. The listing publishes no vote totals or party labels and none are recorded. Wakefield died in May 2026 (she had also been elected to the Selectboard and as a Trustee of Public Funds in March 2026), so no person or membership is minted for her and her seats stand vacant; the four surviving winners are recorded here
